highlights: The up-to-date screen now uses a full illustrated Memory Trail landscape.
Mountains, sunrise, trees, a winding trail, laptop, and success badge make update checks feel more polished.
The current version and build remain visible dynamically.
Keep Exploring still returns you to Memory Trail immediately.

changelog.title: Freshest Trail, Reimagined
items: Replaced the plain update-current screen with a full illustrated Memory Trail scene.
Added a laptop with the real Memory Trail icon and a green success badge.
The version/build pill and Keep Exploring action remain dynamic and functional.

changelog.title: Settings, Repacked
items: Removed the uneven two-column Settings layout that created dead space.
Moved Excluded Apps, Storage & History, and Privacy higher for faster access.
Moved Updates and Help to the bottom of the Settings page.

changelog.title: Exported with Style
items: A new Activity Exported success sheet confirms JSON export completion.
The export sheet shows filename, exported item count, file size, Show in Finder, and Done.
The export tagline is: Your trail. Your data. Your file.

changelog.title: Cleanup with a Smile
items: Clear Last Week uses a playful blue cleanup confirmation.
Clear Last Month uses a purple monthly tidy-up confirmation.
Clear All History and the Today activity-feed trash action use the full-reset confirmation.

changelog.title: Storage & History
items: Memory Trail now stores activity in a clearly named MemoryTrail.store under its local Application Support folder.
Existing default SwiftData history is migrated forward automatically when possible.
Export local history as JSON and manage deletion from Settings.

changelog.title: 30-Day Local Retention
items: Captured history is retained locally for 30 days by default.
Items older than 30 days are removed automatically.
Manual controls can clear the last week, last month, or all history.

changelog.title: Go to Today
items: A Go to Today button appears when browsing earlier dates.
Return to the present day in one click.

changelog.title: Your Day, Remembered
items: Chronological local activity timeline with newest activity first.
Live Activity keeps recent context easy to find.
No AI-generated timeline summaries.

changelog.title: Ask Memory Trail
items: Natural-language local search by time, app, subject, page, conversation, filename, and nearby activity.
Ask what you were doing, what happened before or after something, or which conversations you had today.

changelog.title: Conversations & Chat
items: Supported Microsoft Teams conversation and selected-chat capture.
Generic conversation-title capture for Slack, Discord, Zoom, Webex, Signal, WhatsApp, Telegram, Mattermost, Google Chat, Messages, and compatible chat apps when context is exposed.

changelog.title: Email
items: Supported Outlook subject and sender context.
Useful Mail/email window context when macOS exposes it.

changelog.title: Web & Browsers
items: Supported browser page/tab titles.
URLs when exposed by the browser.

changelog.title: Files & Documents
items: Supported Finder, Preview, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and OneNote context.
File, folder, document, notebook, page, and path information when available.

changelog.title: Clipboard History
items: Local history of supported copied text, links, and code.
Clipboard capture can be disabled at any time.

changelog.title: Favorites & Manual Memories
items: Favorite important timeline entries.
Create manual notes and memories for context you want to preserve yourself.

changelog.title: Insights & Filters
items: Insights for locally captured activity.
Dynamic Today filters based on the activity actually present in your history.

changelog.title: Privacy First
items: Captured activity is sourced, processed, and stored locally using SwiftData.
No Memory Trail account, cloud timeline sync, analytics SDK, advertising SDK, or external timeline service.
Source code is available for review.

changelog.title: Your Controls
items: Pause/resume capture.
App/process exclusions with Wallet and Passwords excluded by default.
Clipboard controls and privacy settings.

changelog.title: Menu Bar & Updates
items: Menu bar operation with quick capture controls.
Manual Check for Updates plus periodic automatic checks.
Version metadata only is used for update checks.

changelog.title: Designed for macOS
items: Native macOS interface and Accessibility integration.
Fast 2-second animated startup.
Requires macOS 14 or later.
